issues.basis: NL2 text; FCSTM state:TargetSearchingState:line:7 has no action field; reference_inspection_facts inventory_receipts.actions count=0; semantic binding of 'UAV swarm target search operation' to TargetSearchingState via source inventory and PlantUML body.
issues.expected: The operating state (TargetSearchingState) must carry a continuous 'target search' do-activity representing the UAV swarm's ongoing search behavior.
issues.observed: The closed model declares zero actions on any state. TargetSearchingState has no entry, do, or exit action. The FCSTM body text contains a description label but no formal action declaration.
issues.reason: The NL explicitly states the UAV 'continuously performs target search tasks,' which is a do-activity obligation on the operating state. The model has no action declarations at all (reference_inspection_facts actions count=0), so the required activity is absent.
issues.requirement_quote: Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks, during which it operates within three different state areas.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The PlantUML body text 'Target Search State' could be interpreted as naming the activity, but in FCSTM formal semantics, state body text is a description/label, not an executable action. No do-activity is formally declared.
issues.title: Missing target search do-activity on operating state

issues.basis: NL4 'After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly'; contract REF-005 binding_hints: state='attack state', variable='number of UAVs in the swarm', effect='decreases'; FCSTM model text shows no variable declarations; inspection_equivalent_facts transitions show transition:line:14 effects=[]; reference_inspection_facts metrics n_variables=0, var_dataflow count=0; semantic binding BIND-ATTACK-STATE confirms AttackState (state:AttackState:line:9) and carrier transition (transition:line:14).
issues.expected: Upon completion of the attack state (transition AttackState → TargetSearchingState on Attack_Completed), the model must declare a variable representing the number of UAVs in the swarm and apply a decrease effect to it.
issues.observed: The FCSTM model declares zero variables (reference_inspection_facts metrics n_variables=0, var_dataflow count=0). No variable or effect representing the UAV count decrease exists anywhere in the closed model.
issues.reason: NL4 requires that after completing the attack, the number of UAVs decreases. This is a variable_delta obligation centered on the attack state. The complete FCSTM model has zero variables and zero effects on any transition. The carrier transition (transition:line:14) has an empty effects list. The required variable declaration and its decrease effect are entirely absent from the closed model. No frozen predicate in the 12-ID registry directly checks variable_delta, so the candidate remains predicate-null W1.
issues.requirement_quote: After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The UAV count decrease could be an external system-level effect not representable as a model-internal variable in a state machine. The NL may describe an operational consequence observable outside the model boundary. However, the NL explicitly states this as a property of the model ('the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly'), and the FCSTM format supports variable declarations and transition effects, so the obligation is within the model's expressive scope and its absence is a genuine gap.
issues.title: UAV count decrease variable-delta missing after attack completion

issues.basis: NL2 'continuously performs target search tasks'; exact_source_inventory.states shows FormationAdjustmentState (source_id=SearchingState.FormationAdjustmentState, line 7, parent=SearchingState) with no outgoing source transition in the complete transition inventory; FCSTM inspection_equivalent_facts.states shows state:FormationAdjustmentState:line:8 with outgoing_transition_refs=[] and reachable_from_initial=true; inspection_equivalent_facts.diagnostics LEAF_WITHOUT_OUTGOING at line 8; verify_facts non_proved deadlock:state:FormationAdjustmentState:line:8 status=refuted outgoing_count=0; working_contract source_to_model confirms FormationAdjustmentState is source-owned; complete FCSTM transition inventory (6 transitions) contains no transition with source=FormationAdjustmentState.
issues.expected: All three operating state areas within the SearchingState composite must maintain progress so the UAV swarm can resume its search operation cycle before mission completion. FormationAdjustmentState, as one of the three operating areas, must have at least one outgoing transition enabling continuation.
issues.observed: FormationAdjustmentState (state:FormationAdjustmentState:line:8) is reachable from the initial state (reachable_from_initial=true) and has zero outgoing transitions (outgoing_transition_refs=[]). The deterministic LEAF_WITHOUT_OUTGOING diagnostic and the refuted deadlock verify fact (outgoing_count=0) confirm this is a reachable, non-final, sequential dead-end. Once the swarm enters formation adjustment upon interception (transition:line:12), it cannot return to TargetSearchingState or any other operating state. The only path to mission completion (TargetSearchingState → FinalWaittr_0006 /Mission_Completed, transition:line:15) is inaccessible from FormationAdjustmentState, permanently breaking the continuous operation required by NL2.
issues.reason: NL2 requires continuous target search operation before mission completion. FormationAdjustmentState is an author-specified operating state (one of the three required state areas) that is reachable in the closed model but has no outgoing transition. The deterministic facts (LEAF_WITHOUT_OUTGOING diagnostic at line 8, refuted deadlock verify fact with outgoing_count=0, empty outgoing_transition_refs) establish reachable, non-final, sequential no-continuation semantics. The state is source-owned per the working contract (not compiler-synthetic like FinalWaittr_0006). V1 applies with initial_scope=SearchingState because the continuity obligation is scoped to this operating composite and the dead-end occurs within it.
issues.requirement_quote: Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks, during which it operates within three different state areas.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: FormationAdjustmentState could be interpreted as a temporary holding state where the swarm awaits external reassignment before resuming search. The NL does not explicitly name the post-adjustment behavior. However, NL2's 'continuously performs target search tasks' establishes that the operating cycle must not be broken by a dead-end in any of the three state areas, and the model provides no mechanism for resumption from FormationAdjustmentState. The absence of any outgoing edge is a definitive no-continuation fact, not an ambiguity about intended behavior.
issues.title: FormationAdjustmentState is a reachable dead-end breaking continuous operation
